resolvedQuestions.text: Does any of the three D5 checks touch the network or spend quota?
resolvedQuestions.answer: No for the Python package (argparse version literal; env/file reads only; only auth test calls the API). The npm --version path is fetch-free; other npm commands may fetch npm metadata at most once per 24h unless JEV_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1.

resolvedQuestions.text: Can a key placed in .claude/settings.json env satisfy the Python gate by accident?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Yes. The Python CLI reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment first and auth status prints stored:true regardless of origin; the same variable name is used by both packages, and the npm docs recommend placing it in the tracked settings env.

resolvedQuestions.text: Does the transcript record the injected brief? (open question 25)
resolvedQuestions.answer: Yes: attachment/hook_success, hookEvent SessionStart, hookName SessionStart:compact, stdout/content holds the brief; at +13 after both boundaries in the sampled file. No PreCompact hook record exists.

resolvedQuestions.text: What is the production budget of a session.compact function hook? (open question 18)
resolvedQuestions.answer: Not stated in the vendored types (which describe 2.1.274; installed host is 2.1.283). The only figure is test-clock prose of ten seconds. Production value remains UNKNOWN.

keyFindings.text: Python jev-cli 0.6.2 --version is a hardcoded literal 'jev 0.6.2', self-attesting rather than package metadata.
npm jevctl --version prints a bare semver, so the exact-match refusal works by print format.
npm jevctl --version performs no network fetch; update check skipped for version/update/help and disabled by JEV_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1.
Python jev-cli resolves TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment first; auth status cannot report an env key as such.
Both packages resolve TYPESAFE_API_KEY; npm docs recommend the tracked-settings env placement (row 43), which also passes the Python gate check.
Exit matrices disagree: Python 0/1/2/3/4/130 vs npm 0/1/2; npm merges usage and transport into exit 1 and auth status exits 1 when none.
Gate: one shell builtin plus two spawns, zero network and zero quota; per-check latency UNKNOWN.
Gate runs once per run or once per session; mid-run exit 3 stops R1 with rows partial and disables the R2 shadow for the session.
R19 and R20 Jev arms have no per-exit-code handling recorded anywhere; inherit R1's by reference.
The version check cannot distinguish a shell wrapper printing 'jev 0.6.2'; printing the resolved path is the mitigation.
Python auth status never prints the key; npm auth status masks it and reports a source column.
Vendored claude-code.d.ts describes Claude Code 2.1.274; installed host is 2.1.283.
No production budget for session.compact is readable; ten seconds is test-clock prose; binary context probe timed out.
On throw, overrun or malformed result the hook is skipped and core (stock summary) runs in its place.
Compact boundary: system/compact_boundary with compactMetadata keys incl. preCompactDiscoveredTools, preservedSegment, preservedMessages; summary is user/isCompactSummary.
The injected brief is recorded in the hook_success SessionStart:compact attachment stdout/content; no PreCompact hook records exist.
precompute installs nothing; its result is kept for the coming compaction if the conversation still leads.
Vendored key resolution order: plugin option, environment, settings env; read outside any gate.
60% auto-compact runs on turn.complete via session.usage() and calls session.compact().
Brief replay inputs are transcript-only; the graph-index half is gone.
R19 brief column: read the recorded injection first; replay buildMergedCompactResult only as fallback.
